results.question: What's our current count of active accounts?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'active' AND mfa_enabled = 1 AND terminated_at IS NULL

results.question: Number of suspended accounts right now?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'suspended' AND date(terminated_at) IS NULL

results.question: Break down our headcount by account status.
results.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM users WHERE status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'terminated') GROUP BY status

results.question: Give me the headcount of each department.
results.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM users GROUP BY department

results.question: What departments exist in the company?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT department FROM users

results.question: What's the total number of apps we manage?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM applications

results.question: Show active staff in Engineering.
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u INNER JOIN group_members gm ON u.id = gm.user_id INNER JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.id WHERE g.name = 'Engineering' AND u.status = 'active' AND u.department = 'Engineering'

results.question: Which active people haven't turned on multi-factor authentication?
results.sql: SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE status = 'active' AND mfa_enabled = 0

results.question: What share of the active workforce uses MFA?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mfa_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 'active'

results.question: How does multi-factor adoption compare across departments among active staff?
results.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(CASE WHEN mfa_enabled = 1 THEN 1 END) AS mfa_adopted, COUNT(CASE WHEN mfa_enabled = 0 THEN 1 END) AS mfa_not_adopted FROM users WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY department

results.question: Look up people with Patel in their name.
results.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.department, u.title, u.manager_id, u.status, u.mfa_enabled, u.created_at, u.terminated_at FROM users u WHERE u.name LIKE '%Patel%'

results.question: Who joined in the past year?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN group_members gm ON u.id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.added_at >= date('2026-11-01', '-1 year')

results.question: For Finance, what roles exist and how many employees have each?
results.sql: SELECT e.name, COUNT(DISTINCT u.email) AS num_employees FROM entitlements e JOIN access_grants ag ON e.id = ag.entitlement_id JOIN users u ON ag.user_id = u.id WHERE e.name IN ('Admin', 'Editor', 'Viewer') AND u.department = 'Finance' GROUP BY e.name

results.question: Who has been terminated, newest departures first, with the dates?
results.sql: SELECT name, email, terminated_at FROM users WHERE status = 'terminated' ORDER BY terminated_at DESC

results.question: Who left the company in the last three months?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND u.terminated_at >= date('2026-11-01', '-90 days')

results.question: Which people manage others, and how many reports does each have?
results.sql: SELECT u1.name, u1.email, u1.department, u1.title, COUNT(u2.id) AS num_reports FROM users u1 INNER JOIN users u2 ON u1.id = u2.manager_id GROUP BY u1.id

results.question: Who works directly under user 5?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u WHERE u.manager_id = 5

results.question: Active employees with nobody listed as their manager?
results.sql: SELECT u.email, u.name FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'active' AND u.manager_id IS NULL

results.question: How many people are in each group?
results.sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) as count FROM groups g JOIN group_members gm ON g.id = gm.group_id JOIN users u ON gm.user_id = u.id GROUP BY g.name

results.question: Show me the privileged groups.
results.sql: SELECT name FROM groups WHERE is_privileged = 1

results.question: List the members of Cloud Admins.
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN group_members gm ON u.id = gm.user_id JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.id WHERE g.name = 'Cloud Admins'

results.question: Which people are in two or more privileged groups?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN group_members gm ON u.id = gm.user_id JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.id WHERE g.is_privileged = 1 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(g.id) >= 2

results.question: Are there any empty groups?
results.sql: SELECT name FROM groups WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT group_id FROM group_members)

results.question: Which departed employees are still in a group?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, g.name AS group_name FROM users u INNER JOIN group_members gm ON u.id = gm.user_id INNER JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND gm.added_at > date('2026-11-01', '-90 days')

results.question: Show every app with its criticality and who owns it.
results.sql: SELECT applications.name, applications.criticality, users.name AS owner_name, users.email AS owner_email FROM applications INNER JOIN users ON applications.owner_user_id = users.id

results.question: Which apps are rated high criticality?
results.sql: SELECT name FROM applications WHERE criticality = 'high'

results.question: Count the apps per identity provider integration.
results.sql: SELECT integration, COUNT(*) as count FROM applications GROUP BY integration

results.question: Which entitlements give admin privileges?
results.sql: SELECT e.name FROM entitlements e WHERE e.is_admin = 1

results.question: Which apps define several admin entitlements?
results.sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(e.id) AS num_admin_entitlements FROM applications a JOIN entitlements e ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 1

results.question: Which person is the owner of the largest number of apps?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, COUNT(a.id) AS num_apps FROM users u JOIN applications a ON u.id = a.owner_user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY num_apps DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What entitlements does the AWS Console offer?
results.sql: SELECT e.name FROM entitlements e JOIN access_grants ag ON e.id = ag.entitlement_id WHERE ag.granted_via = 'direct' AND ag.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'user1@example.com' OR email = 'user2@example.com') AND e.app_id IN (SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name = 'AWS Console')

results.question: Number of grants per application?
results.sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(agr.id) AS num_grants FROM applications a LEFT JOIN entitlements e ON a.id = e.app_id LEFT JOIN access_grants agr ON e.id = agr.entitlement_id GROUP BY a.id

results.question: Split access grants into direct versus group-based.
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, e.name AS entitlement_name, ag.granted_via, ag.granted_at, ag.granted_by, g.name AS group_name FROM access_grants ag INNER JOIN users u ON ag.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id LEFT JOIN groups g ON ag.group_id = g.id WHERE ag.granted_via = 'group' OR (ag.granted_via = 'direct' AND e.is_admin = 1)

results.question: Who holds the largest number of grants?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(ag.id) AS num_grants FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY num_grants DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What can user 100 get into?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email, e.name AS entitlement_name FROM users u INNER JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id INNER JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id WHERE u.id = 100 AND e.is_admin = 0

results.question: Who was given admin rights directly, not via a group?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u INNER JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id INNER JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND ag.granted_via = 'direct'

results.question: Which active users are admins on several different apps?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND e.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) > 1

results.question: Who is a Super Admin in the Okta Admin Console?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u INNER JOIN entitlements e ON u.id = e.app_id INNER JOIN access_grants ag ON e.id = ag.entitlement_id WHERE e.name = 'Admin' AND ag.granted_via = 'direct' AND u.id = ( SELECT owner_user_id FROM applications WHERE name = 'Okta Admin Console' )

results.question: Who can get into Snowflake?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, e.name AS entitlement_name FROM users u INNER JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id INNER JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id WHERE e.name = 'Admin' AND ag.granted_via = 'direct' AND u.status = 'active' AND u.mfa_enabled = 1 AND u.manager_id IS NOT NULL

results.question: Who can use both Salesforce CRM and NetSuite?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id JOIN applications a ON e.app_id = a.id WHERE a.name IN ('Salesforce CRM', 'NetSuite') AND e.is_admin = 1

results.question: Which users have both directly assigned and group-inherited access?
results.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name FROM users u INNER JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id INNER JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id WHERE ag.granted_via = 'direct' AND u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM access_grants WHERE granted_via = 'group')

results.question: Who has left the company but still holds access to something?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND (ag.granted_via = 'direct' OR (ag.granted_via = 'group' AND ag.group_id IS NOT NULL))

results.question: How many departed people still have any access?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND (ag.granted_via = 'direct' OR (ag.granted_via = 'group' AND ag.group_id IS NOT NULL))

results.question: Which former employees still have admin rights?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u INNER JOIN access_grants ag ON u.id = ag.user_id INNER JOIN entitlements e ON ag.entitlement_id = e.id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND e.is_admin = 1 AND ag.granted_at < date('2026-11-01', '-90 days')

results.question: Which departed people can still reach our most critical apps?

results.question: Which apps can ex-employees still get into?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM applications a JOIN entitlements e ON a.id = e.app_id JOIN access_grants ag ON e.id = ag.entitlement_id JOIN users u ON ag.user_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND ag.granted_via = 'direct' AND e.is_admin = 0 AND a.criticality = 'low'

results.question: Which active users haven't been seen in the last 90 days?

results.question: Show every app with its criticality and who owns it.
results.sql: SELECT a.name, a.criticality, u.name AS owner FROM applications a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.owner_user_id

results.question: Which apps are rated high criticality?
results.sql: SELECT name, criticality FROM applications WHERE criticality = 'high'

results.question: Count the apps per identity provider integration.
results.sql: SELECT a.integration, COUNT(*) AS apps FROM applications a GROUP BY a.integration ORDER BY apps DESC, a.integration

results.question: Which entitlements give admin privileges?
results.sql: SELECT e.name AS entitlement FROM entitlements e WHERE e.is_admin = 1

results.question: Which apps define several admin entitlements?
results.sql: SELECT a.name AS application, COUNT(e.id) AS admin_entitlements FROM applications a JOIN entitlements e ON e.app_id = a.id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 1 ORDER BY admin_entitlements DESC, a.name

results.question: Which person is the owner of the largest number of apps?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, COUNT(a.id) AS num_apps FROM applications a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.owner_user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY num_apps DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What entitlements does the AWS Console offer?
results.sql: SELECT e.name AS entitlement FROM entitlements e JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE a.name = 'AWS Console' AND e.is_admin = 1

results.question: Number of grants per application?
results.sql: SELECT a.name AS application, COUNT(g.id) AS grants FROM applications a LEFT JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = a.owner_user_id GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY grants DESC, a.name

results.question: Split access grants into direct versus group-based.
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, e.name AS entitlement, a.name AS application, g.granted_via, g.granted_at, g.granted_by FROM access_grants g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE g.granted_via IN ('direct', 'group')

results.question: Who holds the largest number of grants?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(*) AS grants FROM access_grants g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY grants DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What can user 100 get into?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email, a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE u.id = 100

results.question: Who was given admin rights directly, not via a group?
results.sql: SELECT u.name AS user, u.email AS email, a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement, gb.name AS granted_by FROM access_grants g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id JOIN users gb ON gb.id = g.granted_by JOIN groups grp ON grp.id = g.group_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND g.granted_via = 'direct' AND grp.id IS NULL ORDER BY u.name

results.question: Which active users are admins on several different apps?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, COUNT(DISTINCT e.app_id) AS num_apps FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND e.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.app_id) > 1

results.question: Who is a Super Admin in the Okta Admin Console?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE e.name = 'Super Admin' AND a.name = 'Okta Admin Console' AND e.is_admin = 1

results.question: Who can get into Snowflake?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email, e.name AS entitlement FROM access_grants g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE a.name = 'Snowflake'

results.question: Who can use both Salesforce CRM and NetSuite?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email, e1.name AS entitlement1, e2.name AS entitlement2 FROM access_grants g1 JOIN users u ON u.id = g1.user_id JOIN entitlements e1 ON e1.id = g1.entitlement_id JOIN applications a1 ON a1.id = e1.app_id JOIN access_grants g2 ON g2.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e2 ON e2.id = g2.entitlement_id JOIN applications a2 ON a2.id = e2.app_id WHERE a1.name = 'Salesforce CRM' AND a2.name = 'NetSuite'

results.question: Which users have both directly assigned and group-inherited access?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN access_grants g1 ON g1.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g1.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id JOIN access_grants g2 ON g2.entitlement_id = e.id AND g2.granted_via = 'group' AND g2.group_id IN (SELECT id FROM groups WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM groups WHERE id = g1.group_id)) WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND g1.granted_via = 'direct' AND g2.granted_via = 'group' GROUP BY u.id

results.question: Who has left the company but still holds access to something?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, u.terminated_at, a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND u.terminated_at > date('2026-11-01', '-90 days') ORDER BY u.terminated_at DESC, u.name

results.question: How many departed people still have any access?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.name) AS count FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND g.id IS NOT NULL

results.question: Which former employees still have admin rights?
results.sql:
SELECT u.name, u.email, e.name AS entitlement, a.name AS application
FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id
WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND e.is_admin = 1

results.question: Which departed people can still reach our most critical apps?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, a.name AS application FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND a.criticality = 'high' AND e.is_admin = 0 GROUP BY u.id, a.id ORDER BY u.name

results.question: Which apps can ex-employees still get into?
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement, u.name AS owner, u.email AS owner_email
FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id
WHERE u.status = 'terminated'

results.question: Has any terminated person shown activity after they left?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, u.terminated_at, a.event_type, a.ts FROM users u LEFT JOIN activity_events a ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND a.ts > u.terminated_at

results.question: Which terminated users are fully offboarded with no access left?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, u.terminated_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 'terminated' AND g.id IS NULL AND u.terminated_at >= date('2026-11-01', '-90 days')

results.question: Which active users haven't been seen in the last 90 days?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'active' AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM activity_events WHERE ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-90 days'))

results.question: List administrators who haven't been active for three months.
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, u.department, u.title, u.manager_id, u.status, u.mfa_enabled, u.created_at, u.terminated_at, e.name AS entitlement, a.name AS application FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_events ev WHERE ev.user_id = u.id AND ev.app_id = a.id AND ev.ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-3 months')) ORDER BY u.name, a.name

results.question: What's the number of inactive administrators, meaning 90+ days with no activity?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(u.name) FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'suspended' OR u.status = 'terminated' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_events a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-90 days'))

results.question: Active users with zero recorded activity ever?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, u.department FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_events a WHERE a.user_id = u.id)

results.question: Admins who have never actually done an admin action?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u LEFT JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND e.is_admin = 1 AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM activity_events WHERE event_type = 'admin_action')

results.question: Admins who hold admin rights on apps they haven't touched in 90 days.
results.sql:
SELECT u.name, u.email, a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement
FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id
JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id
WHERE e.is_admin = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_events ev
                  WHERE ev.user_id = u.id AND ev.app_id = a.id AND ev.ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-90 days'))
ORDER BY u.name, a.name

results.question: Active admin count by department.
results.sql: SELECT u.department, COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id) AS admin_count FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND u.status = 'active' GROUP BY u.department ORDER BY admin_count DESC

results.question: Which people in privileged groups are missing multi-factor authentication?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u JOIN group_members gm ON gm.user_id = u.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE g.is_privileged = 1 AND u.status = 'active' AND u.mfa_enabled = 0

results.question: How many privileged accounts have no MFA?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS privileged_accounts_no_mfa FROM users u JOIN group_members gm ON gm.user_id = u.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE g.is_privileged = 1 AND u.status = 'active' AND u.mfa_enabled = 0

results.question: Who gets admin only through a group, never directly?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement, g.granted_at FROM access_grants g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND g.granted_via = 'group' ORDER BY u.name

results.question: Event volume over the last 30 days?
results.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM activity_events WHERE ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-30 days') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

results.question: Event counts broken down by type.
results.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, event_type, COUNT(*) AS events FROM activity_events WHERE ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-7 days') GROUP BY day, event_type ORDER BY day, event_type

results.question: Which apps were busiest over the last 30 days?
results.sql: SELECT a.name AS application, COUNT(*) AS events FROM activity_events ev JOIN applications a ON a.id = ev.app_id WHERE ev.ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-30 days') GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY events DESC

results.question: What fraction of logins fail overall?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS failed_login_fraction FROM activity_events WHERE event_type = 'login'

results.question: Show people who signed in from external IP addresses.
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, ae.ts, ae.ip FROM users u JOIN activity_events ae ON ae.user_id = u.id WHERE ae.event_type = 'login' AND ae.ip NOT LIKE '10.%' AND ae.ip NOT LIKE '172.%' AND ae.ip NOT LIKE '192.%'

results.question: Who carried out the most admin actions?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email, COUNT(*) AS admin_actions FROM activity_events ev JOIN users u ON u.id = ev.user_id WHERE ev.event_type = 'admin_action' GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY admin_actions DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Events per day for the past week.
results.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', ts) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM activity_events WHERE ts >= date('2026-11-01', '-7 days') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

results.question: At what hour do most logins happen?
results.sql: SELECT strftime('%H', ev.ts) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS logins FROM activity_events ev WHERE ev.event_type = 'login' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY logins DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Top 5 apps by number of admin users.
results.sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id) AS admin_users FROM access_grants g JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY admin_users DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which team holds the largest number of admin-level grants?
results.sql: SELECT g.name AS team, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS admin_users FROM access_grants ag JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = ag.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id JOIN users u ON u.id = ag.user_id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.user_id = u.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE e.is_admin = 1 GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY admin_users DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which people in Sales can access Snowflake?
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email, u.status FROM users u JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.user_id = u.id JOIN groups grp ON grp.id = gm.group_id WHERE grp.name = 'Sales' AND a.name = 'Snowflake' ORDER BY u.name

results.question: How many suspended users have MFA disabled?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS suspended_users_without_mfa FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'suspended' AND u.mfa_enabled = 0

results.question: Which applications are integrated through Okta?
results.sql: SELECT a.name AS application, a.integration FROM applications a WHERE a.integration = 'okta'

results.question: List the groups that are not privileged.
results.sql: SELECT name, description FROM groups WHERE is_privileged = 0 ORDER BY name

results.question: How many people are Security Analysts?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS analyst_count FROM users WHERE title = 'Security Analyst'

results.question: How many low criticality applications do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE criticality = 'low'

results.question: How many entitlements are admin entitlements?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS admin_entitlements FROM entitlements WHERE is_admin = 1

results.question: How many active users are in each department?
results.sql: SELECT u.department, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'active' GROUP BY u.department ORDER BY user_count DESC

results.question: Which users have MFA disabled and are suspended?
results.sql: SELECT u.name, u.email FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'suspended' AND u.mfa_enabled = 0
